formulas.delta_compression: send only fields where |new - prev| > threshold; bitmask selects changed fields
formulas.ggpo_rollback: client predicts K frames ahead, re-simulates W frames when server correction arrives

fixed_point_precision.recommendation: Use Q32.32 for physics determinism (better than float32 precision)

implementation_notes: Fixed-point math: replace f32 with Q32.32 in physics core
Snapshot delta: serialize state diff per frame, send over UDP
Bitmask: 2 bytes per frame = 16 fields max per snapshot
GGPO: simulate client + server side-by-side for K frames ahead
Re-simulation: store input buffer of size W, replay on correction
Smoothing: snap to corrected state over 100ms to hide jitter
